description: NaSO₃F crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₃F tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₃F tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. S is bonded to three equivalent O and one F atom to form SO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-56°. All S-O bond lengths are 1.45 Å. The S-F bond length is 1.63 Å. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom.
